title: writeMeshFields
body:
## writeMeshFields

Write unstructured mesh points, cell connectivity and per-time-step point or cell fields to HDF5 with an XDMF 3 temporal description that visualisation tools such as ParaView can open.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Connectivity is zero-based point indices; degenerate cells and out-of-range indices are refused.
- The report includes an independent signed-volume/area total per block as an orientation check.

Native binding: `h5py create_dataset for points, connectivity and per-step fields + XDMF 3 XML describing the HDF5 heavy data`. Output kind: `["file","text"]`.

Inputs: none.
